description: Phase 6ag gate — correlated subqueries. Inner SELECT references columns from enclosing scope. No new VDBE opcodes. max_invariant=43 unchanged. Scope stack in compiler; naive per-outer-row execution.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t1 (a INTEGER, b INTEGER);
SELECT a, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 AS x WHERE x.b < t1.b) FROM t1 ORDER BY a;
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER);
SELECT a FROM t WHERE b > (SELECT AVG(b) FROM t AS x WHERE x.a <= t.a) ORDER BY a;

cases.name: correlated-exists-equivalent-form
cases.description: Pre-6ae: use COUNT(*)>0 trick instead of EXISTS.

program.sql: SELECT a FROM t WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t AS x WHERE x.a = t.a * 2) > 0 ORDER BY a;

cases.name: two-level-nesting
cases.description: Three levels of SELECT, innermost refs outermost.

program.sql: SELECT a, (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t z WHERE z.a = t.a) FROM t y WHERE y.a = 1) FROM t ORDER BY a;
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER);
SELECT SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t AS x WHERE x.b <= t.b)) FROM t;

cases.name: inner-shadowing-outer-alias
cases.description: Inner alias with same name as outer: inner wins within inner scope.

program.sql: SELECT t.a, (SELECT t.a FROM t WHERE t.a = 99) FROM t ORDER BY t.a;

cases.name: qualified-outer-column-ref
cases.description: Explicit outer.col in inner scope — must resolve to outer.

program.sql: SELECT outer_t.a, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inner_t WHERE inner_t.b > outer_t.a) FROM outer_t ORDER BY outer_t.a;

cases.name: correlated-no-rows-yields-null
cases.description: Inner subquery matches no rows → scalar subquery result is Null (per Phase 6n semantics). Correlation via outer column in inner WHERE.

program.sql: SELECT a, (SELECT b FROM u WHERE b = t.a) FROM t ORDER BY a;

cases.name: task81-countstar-correlated-plus-uncorrelated-group-by
cases.description: Task #81 trigger: correlated CountStar + uncorrelated CountStar + GROUP BY. Prior to the fix, the grouped-emit drain phase closed the outer cursor before splicing the correlated-subquery body, so the spliced `Column cursor:0` read panicked with 'Column on closed cursor (compiler bug)'. Fix carries outer-row column values through the sorter as bare-col slots and rewrites spliced outer-cursor reads to Copy from those registers.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER);
SELECT a, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t WHERE a = o.a), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t) FROM t AS o GROUP BY a ORDER BY a;

cases.name: task81-correlated-countstar-alone-group-by-order-by
cases.description: Task #81 isolation: correlated CountStar alone inside GROUP BY + ORDER BY. No uncorrelated sibling. Validates that the outer-column rewrite doesn't depend on having multiple subqueries.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER);
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t WHERE a = o.a) FROM t AS o GROUP BY a ORDER BY a;

cases.name: task81-uncorrelated-countstar-group-by-order-by
cases.description: Task #81 isolation: uncorrelated CountStar inside GROUP BY + ORDER BY. No outer-column reference in the subquery. Regression guard to confirm the fix leaves this previously-working path intact.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER);
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t) FROM t AS o GROUP BY a ORDER BY a;
